name: R-19: GitHub Actions passes on the public repository's launch commit
summary: Launch commit 3c1ed9a1d7ddf2823f4892e94516c9f8b519d80c (R-22). Shipped workflows ['ci.yml', 'cla.yml']. ci.yml runs on push to main and plain pull_request with permissions contents: read, steps npm ci + npm run lint:tsc (D-017; no test step, which D-017 defers). Expected push runs at the SHA = ['CI']; observed runs [('CI', 'push', 'success')], jobs {36719354327: [('check', 'success')]}.

assertions.evidence: ci.yml contains 'run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund' and 'run: npm run lint:tsc'
parsed ci.yml: triggers=['pull_request', 'push'] (no pull_request_target), top-level permissions={'contents': 'read'}, no job-level permission widening
ci.yml documents the D-017 deferral; no public test suite is claimed

limitations: Pull-request-triggered runs do not exist for the launch commit (no external PRs); their trigger safety is verified from the workflow bytes.
